pick.name: Stripe Atlas (Delaware C-corp)
pick.what: Delaware C-corp with EIN, 83(b) filing, YC SAFE templates, next-day filing
pick.why: VC-standard structure; USD 500 one-time incl. first-year registered agent, USD 100/yr after; USD 2,500 Stripe credits; apply from most countries
pick.free_limits: No free tier; USD 500 refundable if USD 5,000 is deposited in Stripe Treasury

best_free.name: DIY Delaware filing (Division of Corporations)
best_free.what: File the certificate of incorporation yourself with the state and appoint your own registered agent
best_free.why: Avoids formation-service fees; you handle EIN, 83(b) and equity paperwork yourself
best_free.free_limits: No service fee, but not free: Delaware incorporation filing USD 109 (fee schedule revised 1 Aug 2026; varies with authorised stock) + optional USD 50 (24h) / USD 100 (same-day) expedite + USD 50 per certified copy; mandatory registered agent (third-party, about USD 50-300/yr); annual franchise tax minimum USD 175 (authorised-shares method) or USD 400 (assumed-par-value method) plus annual report fee; EIN free from the IRS

alts.name: Clerky
alts.why: Law-firm-built docs investors know; USD 427 pay-per-use, USD 819 lifetime package incl. first-year agent
alts.free_limits: No free tier; Pay Per Use USD 427 one-time (state fees not itemised on the page); Lifetime Package USD 819 incl. USD 203 Delaware expedited filing fees and USD 125 first-year registered agent

alts.name: doola
alts.what: LLC or C-corp formation + EIN + address, optional tax/bookkeeping
alts.why: Built for non-US founders; Starter USD 297/yr; tax and compliance tier USD 1,999/yr (carried from earlier pass)
alts.free_limits: No free tier; state fees extra

decision: Default for a startup that may raise venture money is a Delaware C-corp, formed through Stripe Atlas for the lowest all-in first-year cost and broadest country support. Choose an LLC (doola or similar) if you are bootstrapped and want pass-through taxation, or a plain local company if you only sell and hire domestically. Non-US founders owning a US company face home-country tax and foreign-investment rules: verify with a professional.
details: Delaware USD 109 incorporation fee confirmed on the official fee schedule revised 1 Aug 2026. No free option: state filing fees, a registered agent and annual franchise tax cannot be avoided; DIY only removes the service fee. Verify with a professional.

region_notes.US: Delaware C-corp is the VC default; an LLC suits bootstrapped businesses with pass-through tax.
region_notes.EU: A US C-corp with EU-resident founders can trigger local tax residency and CFC rules; some founders use a local GmbH/BV/SAS until a US investor requires Delaware.
region_notes.UK: A UK Ltd is quick and cheap (see local-entity slot); US investors often ask for a Delaware flip.
region_notes.India: Resident Indians owning a foreign company make an Overseas Direct Investment under FEMA/RBI rules (Form ODI via an AD bank plus annual reporting); sole proprietorship or Pvt Ltd is the common domestic start. Take CA advice.

verify.note: Atlas verified: USD 500 one-time incl. Delaware filing (next-day expedited), state fees and first-year registered agent, EIN, founder equity, 83(b) filing; USD 100/yr agent after year one; USD 500 refunded on a USD 5,000 Stripe Treasury deposit; USD 2,500 Stripe credits. Lowest all-in first-year cost vs Clerky (USD 427 + state/agent fees, or USD 819 lifetime incl. USD 203 filing + USD 125 agent).
